payload.subject: Progress report on FIR/2024/001
payload.summary: Surveillance confirms that R. Sharma met D. Khanna at Hotel Sunrise Andheri on 2024-01-28 at approximately 19:00 hrs. R. Sharma arrived in vehicle MH-01-AB-1234. Call records obtained from service provider show R. Sharma (9876543210) made 14 calls to D. Khanna (9988776655) between 2024-01-01 and 2024-01-31. SBI account SBI-SAVE-5678 linked to Priya M. shows outward transfer of INR 2,00,000 to account HDFC-PRIV-1234 (believed to belong to R. Sharma) on 2024-01-27.
payload.next_steps: Obtain bank statements for HDFC-PRIV-1234. Verify vehicle ownership of MH-01-AB-1234.
